main_measure.name: slope of next-day excess return on |forecast|
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope < 0 with t <= -2 and mean short-direction excess return > 0; reject: slope > 0 with t >= +2; inconclusive otherwise; minimum 300 cases on at least 100 distinct days

decided_by: The slope's |t| is below 2, meeting neither the confirm nor the reject rule. No effect (common/verdicts.md): t in the idea's direction +0.031 (below 1), 2502 cases (30 needed).
reading: The falling calm profile is read from the recorded `regime` column (the detector's non-vetoed regime 'unknown'), the 30-day fall from fall30's raw value (recomputed from closes inside the window if missing), the coin's mean daily return is the mean of all its in-window next-day returns over all windows, and the slope's t is an OLS slope with day-clustered standard errors (CR1 factor G/(G-1)).

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction +0.031 (below 1), 2502 cases (30 needed)
